verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows Mailgun documenting React Email, MJML, or any equivalent first-party email-as-code framework, or a workflow for keeping templates in version control. The only template-related item is 'Template Variables' used with mailing lists. That is a sending-time personalization feature, not code-authored templates. The axis plainly applies to an email API provider, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author emails as code — React Email, MJML, or an equivalent maintained framework the vendor documents first-party — and keep templates in version control
